why_next: The audit V1 (severity high) identified a systematic RNG defect: valid_token never experienced triple_br (0/180 reps across all 9 conditions) due to shared proxy-test draw consuming one RNG draw before the measured plan, shifting triple_br draws away from valid_token positions. This means triple-br for the distinct success body — the only body that separates valid_token from the 3-way error collapse — is UNTESTED, not validated. The fix is straightforward: use stratified/round-robin scenario assignment (guaranteeing at least 1 triple_br per state per condition at N=20) instead of uniform random selection, or separate the proxy connectivity-test RNG from the per-request scenario RNG. Rerunning with the same frozen design but corrected sampling would definitively establish or falsify triple-br survival for the success body.

established: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity looping to max_depth=5) restores decompression-normalization under double-brotli encoding for ALL auth states (no_auth, valid_token, expired_token, invalid_token) on localhost mock server with deterministic brotli quality 6: decompressed_body_only_discrimination 0.5 >= 0.3 for JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB, decompressed hash determinism all_same=true, B-RANDOM=0.0.

Triple-brotli encoding (brotli(brotli(brotli(body)))) is successfully decompressed by iterative depth 5 for error states (no_auth/expired_token/invalid_token): 81 observations, 0 decompression errors, all decompressed hashes match single-layer hashes.
Double-brotli for valid_token success body verified: 5-7 reps per condition, decompressed hash d15e53... matches single-layer hash, determinism holds.

Iterative decompression introduces no regressions: single-layer scenarios (correct_br, missing_ce, incorrect_gzip, garbled_ce) maintain identical decompressed hashes, discrimination 0.5, all_same=true.
Decompression latency minimal: 0.012-0.27ms per response, scaling with decompressed size. No crashes/hangs from garbled Content-Encoding headers.
B-SINGLE-PASS-0.2911 baseline exceeded (0.5). B-NO-DOUBLE-BR-0.4486 baseline exceeded (0.5). B-COMPRESSED-BYTE-ONLY 0.266 < 0.5 confirms decompression is necessary.
rejected: Single-pass client decompression does NOT survive double-brotli encoding (parent established, this experiment confirms iterative fix resolves it).
